title: Infrastructure Engineer III
description:
The Infrastructure Patching & Security Engineering team ensures the security, stability, compliance, and operational resilience of enterprise infrastructure platforms through proactive patch management, vulnerability remediation, security hardening, automation, and continuous improvement.

The team is responsible for maintaining secure and compliant Red Hat Linux, Windows environments by implementing enterprise patching strategies, addressing security vulnerabilities, reducing infrastructure risk, and ensuring adherence to organizational security standards.

We are seeking an experienced Infrastructure Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Windows Server, VMware, system administration, OS patching, vulnerability management, infrastructure security, automation, and scripting. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing enterprise-wide patching operations, remediating security vulnerabilities, troubleshooting complex infrastructure issues, and driving automation to improve patch compliance and operational efficiency.

  

**Required Experience & Technical Skills**

* 10 years of overall IT infrastructure, system administration, patch management, or infrastructure security engineering experience.
* Strong hands-on experience managing enterprise-wide operating system patching and vulnerability remediation across large-scale infrastructure environments.
* Extensive expertise in Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL 7/8/9 or later), including administration, patching, kernel upgrades, troubleshooting, and security hardening.
* Strong hands-on experience with Windows Server 2016/2019/2022 or later, including administration, security updates, patch deployment, and troubleshooting.
* Strong experience with VMware vSphere, ESXi, vCenter, virtualization management, patching, and lifecycle operations.
* Hands-on experience with Linux patch management tools such as Red Hat Satellite, YUM, DNF, and RPM.
* Experience with Windows patch management platforms such as SCCM/MECM, WSUS, or equivalent enterprise tools.
* Strong understanding of vulnerability management processes and remediation using tools such as Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7, or equivalent platforms.
* Strong experience with infrastructure automation and configuration management using Ansible.
* Hands-on scripting experience using Python, Bash/Shell scripting, and PowerShell.
* Strong understanding of operating system security hardening, CIS benchmarks, vulnerability remediation, and patch compliance.
* Experience managing critical and high-severity security vulnerabilities and meeting defined remediation SLAs.
* Good understanding of enterprise networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, firewalls, and connectivity troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of enterprise storage technologies, filesystems, and infrastructure performance management.
* Experience with patching governance, change management, incident management, and ITIL processes.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across operating systems, infrastructure security, patching platforms, VMware, networking, and storage.
* Experience supporting large-scale production infrastructure in highly regulated environments.
* Strong communication, documentation, analytical, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) or Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE).
* Microsoft Windows Server or infrastructure certification.
* Red Hat Ansible Automation certification.
* Experience with Red Hat Satellite, Ansible Automation Platform, Microsoft Configuration Manager, and enterprise patch orchestration solutions.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow, CMDB, change management, and automated patch compliance reporting.
* Knowledge of CIS benchmarks, NIST security frameworks, and enterprise security compliance requirements.
* Experience implementing automated vulnerability remediation and infrastructure security controls.

  

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

We’re a team of experts who experiment and work to discover new ways to harness open-source solutions, modern cloud architectures, and sophisticated Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions, while embracing enterprise agile methodologies. * Install, configure, and troubleshoot Linux servers and related hardware/software components

* Proficiency in scripting languages such as Bash or Python for automation, operational support, and task scripting.

* Strong understanding of authentication, privilege management, and integration with Active Directory, including related services such as Kerberos.

* Experience with storage and file-sharing technologies, including local disk management, LVM, network-based storage concepts, HBA/PowerPath, and remote mounts such as CIFS, Samba, and NFS for client and server configurations.

* Working knowledge of networking concepts, protocols, and services, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and related infrastructure services.

* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure, as well as AI tooling to support and streamline technical workloads.

* Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with excellent organizational abilities, attention to detail

title: Infrastructure Specialist, System Administration
description:
Anovia (formerly Innovatia Technical Services) is an industry-leading technology outsourcing support provider with expertise in the telecommunications industry. Operating for over 20 years, we specialize in workflow and knowledge processes, as well as technical support, helpdesk and multilingual support services. With over 200 professional experts across the globe, we service some of the world's most successful Fortune 500 and Fortune 1000 companies.

The Infrastructure Specialist, System Administration will be responsible for providing advanced technical support and leading enterprise server infrastructure operations in a large global client environment. The role requires strong hands-on experience in Linux, Windows Server, or IBM AIX administration, along with expertise in server migrations, virtualization, cloud infrastructure, high availability, clustering, automation, and disaster recovery. The candidate will act as an L3 escalation point, lead complex incident resolution, drive root-cause analysis, and mentor junior administrators.

**Responsibilities**

* Act as the L3 escalation point and technical lead for Linux, Windows or AIX server environments.
* Lead server migrations, OS upgrades and data centre or cloud transitions, including assessment, planning, execution and validation.
* Design and implement high availability and clustering solutions, such as Pacemaker, Windows Failover Clustering or PowerHA.
* Own major incidents end to end, lead root-cause analysis and drive permanent fixes.
* Define and enforce standards for patching, hardening, monitoring and backup across the estate.
* Build automation frameworks with Ansible, Terraform, PowerShell or Python to reduce manual effort.
* Review and approve technical changes, and represent the team in change advisory meetings.
* Mentor L1/L2 administrators and review their work.
* Communicate clearly with client stakeholders on incidents, risks and service improvement plans.
* Maintain architecture documentation, runbooks and knowledge base articles.

**Skills required**

* 6+ years of hands-on administration of Linux (RHEL), Windows Server or IBM AIX in large production environments.
* Proven experience leading OS migrations, upgrades or virtualization and cloud transitions.
* Strong expertise in VMware vSphere and/or Azure or AWS infrastructure.
* Expertise in high availability, clustering and disaster recovery.
* Advanced scripting and automation using Ansible plus Shell, PowerShell or Python.
* Strong knowledge of storage (SAN/NAS, LVM), networking fundamentals, DNS, Active Directory or LDAP, and security hardening.
* Strong ITIL practices and experience owning major incidents and root-cause analysis.
* Excellent written and spoken communication skills for client-facing work.

**Qualifications**

* 8 to 12 years of total experience, with at least 6 years of relevant system administration experience.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT or an equivalent discipline.
* Preferred certifications: RHCSA or RHCE, Microsoft Certified (Windows Server or Azure Administrator), VMware VCP, AWS SysOps Administrator, and ITIL Foundation.
* Experience supporting large-scale enterprise production environments.
* Willingness to support rotational shifts, on-call escalation and weekend change windows when required.
* Ability to work from the client office from day one.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical and communication skills.

**Good to have**

* Terraform and infrastructure-as-code pipelines.
* Kubernetes or Red Hat OpenShift administration.
* Middleware administration (WebSphere, WebLogic, JBoss).
* IBM Power Systems: PowerVM, VIOS, NIM and LPAR management.
* Workload automation tools such as Control-M.

**Benefits at Anovia**

* Comprehensive Health Insurance policy
* Employee Wellness Program with focus on mental health
* Robust reward and recognition programs
* Company incentive programs offered.
* Attractive leave policy: Holiday Leave, Maternity Leave, Paternity Leave, Birthday leave, Bereavement Leave and Paid Leave for personal time off
* Ample growth and learning opportunities.
* Remote work opportunities
* Focus on work/life balance.
* Immigration Program supporting immigration to Canada for eligible employees.

We thank all candidates for their interest; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

Anovia is an equal opportunity employer.
